## 工作流程概述

这是 Ideogram4 的完全自动化、便捷的文本到图像工作流程。由于模型对 JSON 结构的提示响应最佳，因此此工作流默认连接大型语言模型 (LLM)，以自动将自然语言输入转换为所需的 JSON 格式，从而实现无缝生成管道。

## 核心特性

- 全自动提示转换：集成LLM接口，自动将用户自然语言描述转换为模型首选的JSON提示结构。

- 开放权重模型：基于目前最好的开源图像生成器Ideogram4，强烈倾向于设计生产力和艺术美学。

- 逼真的皮肤纹理：生成的肖像保留自然的皮肤细节和瑕疵，避免过度喷枪、塑料外观，以获得更大的真实感。

- 优秀的图像文本：擅长生成带有准确嵌入文本的图像，使其非常适合海报、广告和封面设计。

## Workflow Overview

This is a fully automated, convenient text-to-image workflow for Ideogram4. Since the model responds best to JSON-structured prompts, this workflow defaults to connecting a large language model (LLM) to automatically convert natural language inputs into the required JSON format, enabling a seamless generation pipeline.

## Core Features

- Fully Automatic Prompt Conversion:Integrates an LLM interface to automatically translate user natural language descriptions into the JSON prompt structure preferred by the model.

- Open-Weights Model:Based on Ideogram4, currently the best open-source image generator, with a strong tilt toward design productivity and artistic aesthetics.

- Realistic Skin Texture:Generated portraits retain natural skin details and imperfections, avoiding an over-airbrushed, plastic look for greater realism.

- Excellent Text-in-Image:Excels at generating images with accurate, embedded text, making it perfect for posters, ads, and cover designs.
